flow: Operator completes Cloudflare Access login via browser
Worker logs non-secret assertion headers in safe test harness
Exact opaque accessSubject string captured from sub claim
Exact authenticated email string captured from email claim (<= 320 chars)
Confirm accessSubject is not assumed permanent or UUID
step6_operatorAccessLoginAndCapture.rollback: Invalidate Access session / revoke Access token

step7_superadminRegistryEnrollment.rollback: Set status to suspended or empty registry array

specifications.identityBinding: Exact Ed25519 public key pem and authorityId matching authorized human operator
specifications.commitTreeBinding: Source commit SHA and source tree SHA strictly validated against canonical Git state
specifications.expiry: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp enforced; max authorization window <= 15 minutes (900 seconds)
specifications.rotation: Static versioned replacement only; zero dynamic/remote rotation in production
specifications.revocation: Explicit revocation list or status: suspended in registry; immediate fail-closed
specifications.antiReplay: Single-use run_nonce and payload digest registered atomically in D1 authorization_replay_ledger
specifications.evidence: Cryptographic signature receipt stored with invocation metadata; zero secret leakage
specifications.failClosedSemantics: Any missing, invalid, expired, or non-matching attestation fails closed with 401/403

step8_trustAnchorPackage.rollback: Set all 4 trust flags to false and clear registries

verificationSteps: Verify table authorization_replay_ledger exists with 64-char hex primary key constraint
Execute atomic reservation test: insert row, verify conflict on duplicate replay_key, clean up test row

step10_dormantRoutePassivityVerification.routeActivationPolicy: Route activation moves strictly to HARD GATE 2 and requires explicit human approval.
